title: Looking back and goodbyes
summary: She would live it again, one-nighters and starvation included, and the interview closes.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant

blocks.x: From a distance. I want to get the argument about how these things break. How do you feel now? You've lived your life -
But I don't feel that I have. I don't know if I'm old, white, or black.
You haven't finished it. It's still going on, sure. But how do you feel about how it's worked out for you so far?
Beautiful. I'd live it again, go over the same things, one-nighters with Andy Kirk, starvation, and many, many things that happened. I'd go over it again.
If you went over it again do you feel that you would do it any better than you did it this time?

I think we all would if we experienced a lot of things. We'd know how to do them, but I think we'd do worse if we haven't experienced anything. But if I have experienced something and had to go over it again I think I'd do it better.
Most of us would. Well, any thing more you want to say?
Not right now. I'll remember something when you get home.
We'll pick it up later then.
